notes.title: A demo version of "Midnight Ramen" is coming before the end of 2023!
notes.notes:
Around the middle of December, before the end of 2023, we will release a DEMO version of the game.
Offering a taste of approximately 30 minutes of content with two chapters.

Stay tuned!

--

Inspired by the TV series "Midnight Diner," as well as games like Coffee Talk and VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action, Midnight Ramen is a soothing interactive novel developed by Cointinue Games.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711317/a47f966361a3b7083739275d62e250a23fd62b29.png[/img]

Game Features:
[list]
[*] Captivating storyline
[*] Immersive dialog-driven experience
[*] User-friendly ramen cooking system
[*] Convenient chapter navigation
[/list]
